content.title: 34 Pi Day Deals for a Slice of Savings on 3.14
content.text: You don’t have to be a mathematician to appreciate Pi Day. Each year on March 14, food lovers celebrate the famous mathematical number know as 3.14 by indulging in some sweet and savory pies (aka pizzas). This year, many restaurants and food brands are cooking up deals ranging from freebies to massive discounts. Below, we’re rounding up all the offers you’ll want to chase down this weekend.&pizza To celebrate Pi Day, &pizza customers can purchase pies for $3.14 when they buy another pie and use the code PIDAY.7-Eleven7-Eleven has the following offers for Pi Day:$3.14 whole pizza for 7Rewards and Speedy Rewards members in stores and in the 7NOW Delivery app. Speedy Café customers can also order a large one-topping pizza for the same price.Laredo Taco Company is selling quesadillas for $3.14.Raise the Roost restaurants are selling Cinnamon Sugar Fried Pies for 31.4 cents.$1 for 7-Select Snack PiesBJ’s Restaurant & Brewhouse On Pi Day, BJ’s Restaurant & Brewhouse customers can order a large or shareable pizza and get a full-size classic Pizookie for $3.14 while dining in or placing a dine-out order.Blaze Pizza Blaze Pizza is running the following deal for Pi Day: Buy one 11-inch pizza, get a second 11-inch pizza of equal or lesser value for $3.14.Burger KingBurger King Royal Perks members can get a free Hershey’s Sundae Pie or Cinnamon Apple Pie with a $3.14 purchase while ordering in the chain’s app or website on March 14.DoorDashDoorDash is running the following deals: Pizza Hut: On Pi Day, customers can buy one medium or large Create Your Own pizza and get one free at participating locations while supplies last.Sbarro: Between March 14 — April 6, DashPass members can save $4 off eligible orders of $20 or more from participating Sbarro locations on DoorDash. Additionally, DashPass members can save $5 off eligible orders of $25 or more from participating locations.Blaze Pizza: Between March 14 — April 6, customers who buy one Simple Pie 11-inch cheese pizza will get one free from participating locations while supplies last.Fresh BrothersFresh Brothers customers can order a personal pizza (Pure Pepperoni Pizza Original Crust or the Cheese Pizza Original Crust) for $3.14 while ordering online and using the code PIDAY on March 14.Goode Co. TODAY.com readers can use the code TODAY15 to save 15% off all pie products at the Goode Co. online shop when they make a minimum purchase of $40. The single-use offer can’t be combined with other discounts and is valid through March 31.Gopuff Gopuff is discounting select pie products, including Edwards Frozen Hershey’s Chocolate Cream Pie Slices and Edwards Frozen Key Lime Pie Slices, which will be 25% off on the holiday.Instacart On March 14, Instacart users can get a free Red Baron pizza with their order while supplies last.Keebler Keebler fans can get a free Keebler Pi(e) Day Prize Pack for trying to complete the digits of pi as part of an Instagram giveaway that runs through March 20.Little CaesarsJust in time for Pi Day, Little Caesars customers can order two or more select items for $5.99/$6.99 from the limited-time Mix-N-Match Menu in the chain’s app or in participating restaurants.Little Pie CompanyLittle Pie Company is giving away a free Pi cookie to every customer all day on the holiday.Marco’s PizzaMarco’s Pizza customers can get a medium one-topping pizza for $3.14 when they buy a large or extra large pizza on the holiday and use the code PIDAY.Matchbox RestaurantsMatchbox Restaurants customers who buy any regular-priced pizza on the holiday will get another for 50% off in stores or online with the code PIEDAY.Miami GrillOn March 14, Miami Grill customers can get a slice of Key Lime Pie for $3.14.Milton’s Through March 29, Costco customers can save $4 on the purchase of a two-pack of Milton’s Roasted Vegetable Cauliflower Crust Pizza.MOD PizzaThe first 314 MOD Pizza rewards members to buy a mod-size pizza or salad on the holiday will pay $3.14. Additional purchases of mod-size pizza or salad will receive a discount of $3.14 through 3:14 p.m. local time.Mountain Mike’s PizzaMountain Mike’s Pizza rewards members can get a medium one-topping pizza for $3.14 when they buy another medium pizza on Pi Day.Paisano’sPaisano’s is selling large cheese pizzas for $3.14 on March 14 on orders over $20 with the code PIDAY.Papa Murphy’s Papa Murphy’s customers can save 31.4% off regular-priced items on the holiday with the code PIDAY26.Pizza HutJust in time for Pi Day, Pizza Hut is selling a $10 large three-topping pizza. Customers can choose from three crust options, including the new Hand-Tossed crust. The deal is valid at participating locations while supplies last.PLNT Burger PLNT Burger customers can order Crispy Herb Fries with their choice of sauce for $3.14 between March 14 — 15 with the code PIDAYFRY.Polly’s PiesPolly’s Pies is running the following deals on the holiday:Free slice of pie with any entrée purchase for dine-in guests Free slice for Polly’s Perks members dining in (no purchase required)Portillo’s Portillo’s Perks members can order a slice of cake for $1 with any purchase on the holiday.Prime PizzaPrime Pizza is selling two cheese pies for $31.40 on March 14.Round Table PizzaAt participating Round Table Pizza locations, rewards members can get a one-topping personal pizza for $3.14 on the holiday when they buy a large or extra large pizza.Sal’s Pizza Select Sal’s Pizza locations will offer the following deal in-store and online on Pi Day: Order two 12-inch cheese pizzas for $9.99, two 16-inch cheese pizzas for $19.99 or two 19-inch cheese pizzas for $29.99.Save A LotSave A Lot is selling Mantia’s Rising Crust Pizzas for $3.14 on the holiday, with a limit of two per customer.Schlotzsky’s Deli Every Friday — Sunday after 5 p.m., including Pi Day, Schlotzsky’s Deli customers can order core pizzas for $5 and premium pies for $7 at participating locations.SheetzSheetz is selling cheese or pepperoni pizza flatz for $3.14 between March 14 — 20. The single-use offer is valid in the chain’s app.The Brass TapThe Brass Tap is serving $12 pizzas all day on Pi Day.Village InnVillage Inn customers can order a slice of pie for $3.14 on March 14.Wiseguy PizzaWiseguy Pizza’s in-store and online Pi Day deal entitles customers to New York-style cheese and pepperoni slices for $3.14 with the code PIDAY2026.
